title: Flip receipt
description: Printed by `coin flip --json`: one flip from the entropy pool, and everything it came from. With the archived run in data/runs and the batch's recorded seed, the bit can be recomputed.

flipped_at.description: When the bit was spent, ISO 8601 in UTC.

backend.description: The IBM device the shots ran on.

qubit.description: The physical qubit that was flipped; null for a certified bit, which comes from a pair (certificate.qubits).

run.description: The archived run's directory under data/runs/.

harvested_at.description: When the batch entered the pool, ISO 8601 in UTC.

batch.description: The pool batch the bit came from.

offset.description: The bit's position in its batch, from 0.

batch_bits.description: How many bits the batch holds.

entropy_per_bit.description: Min-entropy per input bit the extraction spent: half the estimate for a harvest, the certified rate's share for a certified bit.

epsilon.description: Distance from uniform, if that min-entropy holds.

certified.description: Whether a Bell violation vouches for the bit (coin certify), rather than the hardware's noise alone.

certificate.description: Only on a certified bit: the CHSH run behind it.

qubits.description: The pair the CHSH test ran on.

s_low.description: Hoeffding's lower bound on S at s_epsilon.

s_epsilon.description: The probability S_low is wrong, if rounds are independent.

rate_per_round.description: Min-entropy of a round's two outcome bits that S_low certifies (Pironio et al., 2010).

settings_batches.description: The pool batches whose bits chose the run's settings.
